g.text: Architecture: candidates in the prompt, scores at special tokens
pretrained MLLM (Qwen3.5-4B or Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), final MLP removed
shared scorer → one score s_i per candidate
Why it works with one causal pass
each candidate readout sees the video, the query and
earlier candidates; <|decide|> sees the whole list
two new tokens (initialised from <|im_end|>), no LM
head, no final MLP; the vision encoder stays frozen
